title: LOCI: A Locator-Critic with Refinement Loop
abstract: arXiv:2608.30959v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) still struggle on tasks requiring complex visual understanding. We argue that the core issue is not high-level reasoning, but instead failing to locate critical details in the image. Due to this shortcoming, VLMs generate often plausible but incorrect reasoning based on flawed perceptual grounding. To address this, we propose Locator-Critic (LOCI), a training-free framework that decouples visual search from evidence verification. LOCI employs a Locator agent to propose candidate visual evidence and a separate Critic agent to evaluate its relevance and sufficiency. These agents engage in an iterative refinement loop, progressively improving the evidence until it is adequate to answer the given question. This decoupled, self-correcting process yields substantial performance gains, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple complex visual benchmarks. translated_title: LOCI：一种带精炼循环的定位器-评论家框架
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在需要复杂视觉理解的任务上仍然表现不佳。我们认为其核心问题不在于高层推理，而在于未能定位图像中的关键细节。由于这一缺陷，视觉语言模型经常基于有缺陷的感知基础生成看似合理却错误的推理。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Locator-Critic（LOCI），这是一个无需训练的框架，将视觉搜索与证据验证解耦。LOCI使用一个定位器智能体来提出候选视觉证据，并使用一个独立的评论家智能体来评估证据的相关性和充分性。这些智能体参与一个迭代精炼循环，逐步改进证据，直到其足以回答给定的问题。这种解耦的、自我纠正的过程带来了显著的性能提升，在多个复杂视觉基准上取得了最先进的结果。LOCI提高了开源权重模型（如……）的准确率。
tldr: 提出无需训练的Locator-Critic（LOCI）框架，通过定位器智能体提出候选视觉证据、评论家智能体评估其相关性与充分性，并经迭代精炼循环实现自我纠正，将视觉搜索与证据验证解耦，在多个复杂视觉基准上取得最先进性能。
